governing_question: Can the native AuthorityResolution representation still construct an ESTABLISHED executable authority while preserving a contradictory same-lineage authority observation?
successor_control: For an ESTABLISHED AuthorityResolution, every supplied observation must equal the executable AuthorityState carried by that resolution.
negative_control: Attempt direct native construction with ACTIVE epoch 1 executable authority plus same-lineage REVOKED epoch 2 observation.
positive_controls: Direct ESTABLISHED construction with duplicate identical observations remains constructible.
expected_negative_result: ValueError: ESTABLISHED resolution observations must match executable authority
bounded_claim: This successor test establishes only representation-level coherence enforcement for supplied AuthorityResolution observations. It does not establish observation authenticity, resolver correctness, distributed consensus, freshness, external provenance, or production deployment behavior.
